basic_details.job_title: MAHE Project Research Scientist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) has notified 1 vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) on a project-based engagement. The tenure is initially for a period of one year and extendable based on performance and need of the project, with a pay of Rs. 56,000 + 10% HRA. Candidates applying for the post must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmaceutical Chemistry) or integrated PG degrees with three years’ experience or PhD. Eligible applicants can apply by email by sending a detailed CV and supporting documents with the Job Code i

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates via email

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed CV along with supporting documents for qualification and experience.
Ensure the mandatory Job Code ICMR funded project: PRS – I (Non-Medical), Pharmaceutical Chemistry, MCOPS, Manipal is mentioned in the subject line of the email.
Send the application via email to [email protected] with a copy marked to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Submit the application on or before October 19, 2026.

content_sections.heading: MAHE Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical) at a Glance

rows.details: Department of Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Manipal College of Pharmaceutical Sciences (MCOPS)
Computational Design, Synthesis, and Biological Evaluation of Di-Phenyl Ether-Based Slow-Onset InhA Inhibitors with Optimized Residence Time Against Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis
Initially for one year, extendable based on performance and need

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification and eligibility criteria prescribed for the project position: Educational Qualification: First Class Post Graduate Degree (Pharm D/M Pharm – Pharmaceutical Chemistry) or integrated PG degrees with three years’ experience or PhD. Essential Experience: Prior research experience in in-silico modelling, synthesis, and in-vitro assays.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 56,000/- plus 10% HRA under the ICMR-funded project. The engagement is initially for one year and is extendable depending on project requirements and the candidate's performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAHE Project Research Scientist - I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV along with supporting documents for qualification and experience. Ensure the mandatory Job Code ICMR funded project: PRS – I (Non-Medical), Pharmaceutical Chemistry, MCOPS, Manipal is mentioned in the subject line of the email. Send the application via email to [email protected] with a copy marked to the Principal Investigator at [email protected] . Submit the application on or before October 19, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened by the department, and shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview date via e-mail. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.
